# What the level and the stage give this country now. Run yearly, on creation, on becoming or stopping being
# a subject, and for every AI when the level changes. A human country only loses them.

# This human's design score per unit type (the Warforged designer's totals).
DA_AI_design_score = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_INFAN which = DA_power_TOTAL_INFAN }
	set_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_tmp which = DA_fire_TOTAL_INFAN }
	change_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_tmp which = DA_shock_TOTAL_INFAN }
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_tmp which = DA_Fire_rec_TOTAL_INFAN }
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_tmp which = DA_Shock_rec_TOTAL_INFAN }
	divide_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_tmp value = 2 }
	change_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_INFAN which = DA_AI_score_tmp }
	set_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_CAVAL which = DA_power_TOTAL_CAVAL }
	set_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_tmp which = DA_fire_TOTAL_CAVAL }
	change_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_tmp which = DA_shock_TOTAL_CAVAL }
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_tmp which = DA_Fire_rec_TOTAL_CAVAL }
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_tmp which = DA_Shock_rec_TOTAL_CAVAL }
	divide_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_tmp value = 2 }
	change_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_CAVAL which = DA_AI_score_tmp }
	set_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_ARTIL which = DA_power_TOTAL_ARTIL }
	set_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_tmp which = DA_fire_TOTAL_ARTIL }
	change_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_tmp which = DA_shock_TOTAL_ARTIL }
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_tmp which = DA_Fire_rec_TOTAL_ARTIL }
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_tmp which = DA_Shock_rec_TOTAL_ARTIL }
	divide_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_tmp value = 2 }
	change_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_ARTIL which = DA_AI_score_tmp }
}

# The best human design per unit type, in steps of 5%, as global flags DA_AI_best_<unit>_<step>. Yearly, by humans.
DA_AI_update_design_flags = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { ai = no }
		DA_AI_design_score = yes
	}
	clr_global_flag = DA_AI_best_INFAN_1

	clr_global_flag = DA_AI_best_INFAN_19
	clr_global_flag = DA_AI_best_INFAN_20

		limit = { any_country = { ai = no check_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_INFAN value = 1 } } }
		set_global_flag = DA_AI_best_INFAN_20
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_country = { ai = no check_variable = { which = DA_AI_score_INFAN value = 0.95 } } }

# A new level, for the whole game: every AI country follows at once.
# The options of the events show what it gives (option_tooltip); this effect shows nothing.
DA_AI_set_level = {
	hidden_effect = {
		clr_global_flag = DA_AI_level_none
		clr_global_flag = DA_AI_level_easy
		clr_global_flag = DA_AI_level_normal
		clr_global_flag = DA_AI_level_hard
		clr_global_flag = DA_AI_level_very_hard
		set_global_flag = DA_AI_level_$level$
		DA_AI_update_design_flags = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = { ai = yes }
			DA_AI_buffs_refresh = yes
		}
	}
}

# Every stage that has come (its institution has appeared in the world) gets a global flag. Silent.
DA_AI_stage_mark = {
	if = { limit = { is_institution_enabled = renaissance } set_global_flag = DA_AI_stage_1 }
	if = { limit = { is_institution_enabled = new_world_i } set_global_flag = DA_AI_stage_2 }
	if = { limit = { is_institution_enabled = printing_press } set_global_flag = DA_AI_stage_3 }
	if = { limit = { is_institution_enabled = global_trade } set_global_flag = DA_AI_stage_4 }
	if = { limit = { is_institution_enabled = manufactories } set_global_flag = DA_AI_stage_5 }
	if = { limit = { is_institution_enabled = enlightenment } set_global_flag = DA_AI_stage_6 }
	if = { limit = { is_institution_enabled = industrialization } set_global_flag = DA_AI_stage_7 }
}

# Yearly, by humans: the latest stage has no flag yet, so it has just come. Mark it and tell every human
# player (DA_AI_Strength.3), unless the level is None.
DA_AI_stage_check = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_institution_enabled = industrialization }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = DA_AI_stage_7 } }
			DA_AI_stage_mark = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { DA_AI_level_none = yes } }
				every_country = { limit = { ai = no } country_event = { id = DA_AI_Strength.3 } }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_institution_enabled = enlightenment }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = DA_AI_stage_6 } }
			DA_AI_stage_mark = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { DA_AI_level_none = yes } }
				every_country = { limit = { ai = no } country_event = { id = DA_AI_Strength.3 } }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_institution_enabled = manufactories }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = DA_AI_stage_5 } }
			DA_AI_stage_mark = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { DA_AI_level_none = yes } }
				every_country = { limit = { ai = no } country_event = { id = DA_AI_Strength.3 } }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_institution_enabled = global_trade }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = DA_AI_stage_4 } }
			DA_AI_stage_mark = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { DA_AI_level_none = yes } }
				every_country = { limit = { ai = no } country_event = { id = DA_AI_Strength.3 } }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_institution_enabled = printing_press }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = DA_AI_stage_3 } }
			DA_AI_stage_mark = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { DA_AI_level_none = yes } }
				every_country = { limit = { ai = no } country_event = { id = DA_AI_Strength.3 } }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_institution_enabled = new_world_i }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = DA_AI_stage_2 } }
			DA_AI_stage_mark = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { DA_AI_level_none = yes } }
				every_country = { limit = { ai = no } country_event = { id = DA_AI_Strength.3 } }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_institution_enabled = renaissance }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = DA_AI_stage_1 } }
			DA_AI_stage_mark = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { DA_AI_level_none = yes } }
				every_country = { limit = { ai = no } country_event = { id = DA_AI_Strength.3 } }
			}
		}
	}
}
